# skycloak_smtp (Resource)

SMTP configuration for a realm (a singleton; create == update upsert).

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "skycloak_smtp" "app" {
  cluster_id = skycloak_cluster.production.id
  realm_name = skycloak_realm.app.name

  host       = "smtp.example.com"
  port       = 587
  encryption = "starttls"
  from_email = "no-reply@example.com"
  from_name  = "Example App"

  auth_type = "basic"
  username  = "smtp-user"
  password  = var.smtp_password # write-only; omit on later applies to keep it
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `auth_type` (String) Authentication type: `basic` or `oauth2`.
- `cluster_id` (String) Cluster ID. Immutable.
- `from_email` (String) Sender email address.
- `host` (String) SMTP server hostname or IP.
- `port` (Number) SMTP server port (1-65535), e.g. 587.
- `realm_name` (String) Realm name. Immutable.

### Optional

- `client_id` (String) OAuth 2.0 client ID (when `auth_type` is `oauth2`).
- `client_secret` (String, Sensitive) OAuth 2.0 client secret. Write-only; never read back. Omit to retain the stored value.
- `encryption` (String) Encryption mode: `none`, `ssl`, or `starttls`. Defaults to `none`.
- `from_name` (String) Sender display name.
- `password` (String, Sensitive) SMTP password (when `auth_type` is `basic`). Write-only; never read back. Omit to retain the stored value.
- `token_scope` (String) OAuth 2.0 token scope (when `auth_type` is `oauth2`).
- `token_url` (String) OAuth 2.0 token endpoint (when `auth_type` is `oauth2`).
- `username` (String) SMTP username (when `auth_type` is `basic`).

### Read-Only

- `has_client_secret` (Boolean) Whether a client secret is stored.
- `has_password` (Boolean) Whether a password is stored.
- `id` (String) Composite ID `cluster_id/realm_name/smtp`.
- `status` (String) Configuration status (`configured`, `verified`, `failed`).
